name: Automatic Light Bar Placement Machine
summary: Precisely and quickly places LED light bars at designated positions. Can pick multiple light bars at once, with pressure holding function to ensure assembly accuracy.
contentHtml:
The automatic light bar placement machine uses a robotic unit to automate light bar placement.

Working Principle

It uses a robot with a vision system to precisely pick 7 light bars and place them at target positions in one go. The equipment has a pressure holding function to ensure the light bars are firmly fixed.

Technical Advantages

  • Assembly accuracy of ±0.2mm
  • Can pick 7 light bars at once, high efficiency
  • Pressure holding function ensures assembly quality
  • Supports CAD import for quick changeover
